'''Will of the Emperor''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] employed by the infamous master of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Tenebrae]]. When one was casting the power, it would release a [[Color/Legends|purple]] beam of Force energy, those who were hit were pinned down to the ground. Tenebrae made use of this during the fight that lead to his final [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught" />
